name: MACD Stochastic 2
summary: This EA combines MACD and Stochastic oscillator signals to generate trade entries. It uses MACD for trend direction confirmation and Stochastic for overbought/oversold momentum timing. Trades are opened when both indicators align, providing a dual-confirmation momentum trading system.
summary_zh: 该EA结合MACD和随机指标（Stochastic）信号来生成交易入场。使用MACD确认趋势方向，使用随机指标判断超买超卖的动量时机。当两个指标信号一致时开仓，提供双重确认的动量交易系统。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于MACD与随机指标的双重确认动量交易系统。入场条件为：做多时MACD主线位于信号线上方且Stochastic从超卖区域上穿；做空时MACD主线位于信号线下方且Stochastic从超买区域下穿。出场条件通常依赖固定止盈止损或指标反转信号。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏风险比例控制，未实现根据波动率自适应调整仓位的功能。整体策略逻辑清晰，但缺少对市场状态（趋势/震荡）的区分过滤机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual-confirmation momentum trading system combining MACD and Stochastic indicators. Entry conditions: for long trades, MACD main line must be above the signal line and Stochastic crosses up from the oversold zone; for short trades, MACD main line must be below the signal line and Stochastic crosses down from the overbought zone. Exit conditions rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or indicator reversal signals. Position sizing uses fixed lots without dynamic adjustment based on account equity. Money management lacks risk-proportional control and does not implement volatility-adaptive position sizing. The overall strategy logic is clear but lacks a market state filter (trending vs ranging) to avoid whipsaws in sideways markets.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss amount, 0 disables overall stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Hedge pair net profit target in points

pros: 双指标确认机制减少了假信号，提高了入场质量
MACD与Stochastic互补：MACD捕捉趋势方向，Stochastic精确定位入场时机
策略逻辑直观易懂，便于参数优化和回测验证
pros_en: Dual-indicator confirmation reduces false signals and improves entry quality
MACD and Stochastic are complementary: MACD captures trend direction while Stochastic pinpoints entry timing
Strategy logic is intuitive and easy to understand, facilitating parameter optimization and backtesting
cons: 固定手数不考虑账户规模变化，资金管理不够灵活
缺乏市场状态过滤，震荡行情中容易产生频繁亏损信号
未实现新K线检测机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing does not adapt to account size changes, making money management inflexible
Lacks market state filtering, prone to frequent losing signals in ranging markets
No new bar detection mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same bar
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整出场水平
添加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更高周期MA），避免在震荡行情中频繁交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit for volatility-adaptive exit levels
Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher timeframe MA) to avoid frequent trading in ranging markets

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检测可能导致同一根K线上重复开仓
固定手数未根据账户风险承受能力动态调整
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下入场成本可能过高
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar detection may cause duplicate position openings on the same bar
Fixed lot size does not dynamically adjust based on account risk tolerance
No spread filter, entry costs may be too high in high-spread environments

summary_en: This EA combines MACD and Stochastic oscillator signals to generate trade entries. It uses MACD for trend direction confirmation and Stochastic for overbought/oversold momentum timing. Trades are opened when both indicators align, providing a dual-confirmation momentum trading system.
